name: capa
title: capa (Mandiant)
description: Finds the capabilities of a PE, ELF or .NET binary or shellcode with Mandiant capa and the capa-rules set, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and MBC. Files are read from the folder mounted at /work (capa_analyze takes /work/<file>). No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, FuzzingLabs) AND Apache-2.0 (capa, capa-rules)

mounts.description: The folder with the samples to analyze (read-only is enough)

notes: Large binaries can exceed axross's 512 MiB container memory limit or the 300 s default timeout; capa_analyze takes a timeout of up to 3600 s.
